finding.title: Inject LocalDayClock into ParentDashboardAggregator instead of hardcoding SystemLocalDayClock
finding.why: compute({DateTime? now}) documents now as 'pass explicitly for testability', and every other metric (pace, engagement, recent-completions window) honors it — but the streak sub-computation always builds StreakStateProvider with a hardcoded SystemLocalDayClock(), which reads real DateTime.now() regardless of the now argument. The accompanying test cannot control this and is forced to call real DateTime.now() to seed matching streak_events (quoted comment at lines 119-121 explains exactly why), making that test a genuine wall-clock dependency and leaving a live day-boundary race: if the wall clock ticks past local midnight between the caller choosing now and StreakStateProvider's internal clock read, currentStreak/maxStreak reflect a different 'today' than the rest of the ParentDashboardData snapshot.
finding.recommendation: Accept an optional LocalDayClock clock constructor parameter (default const SystemLocalDayClock()), pass it into StreakStateProvider, and derive it from the aggregator's own now so compute(now: ...) fully determines the snapshot including streak.
acceptance_criteria: A new unit test overrides the injected clock (not real DateTime.now()) and asserts currentStreak/maxStreak for a fixed 'today', replacing the wall-clock seeding at parent_dashboard_aggregator_compute_test.dart:118-122.
The TQ-6 hermetic-test grep (no DateTime.now() outside core/time) passes for this test file.

finding.title: Delete or wire up the unused ChazaraStatus/MomentumStatus domain models and their barrel
finding.why: Repo-wide grep for ChazaraStatus, MomentumStatus, and this models.dart barrel path finds no reference anywhere outside their own declaration and generated .freezed.dart files — no provider constructs them, no widget renders them. They are fully-specified, richly-documented (momentum thresholds, chazara due/overdue semantics) value classes for a feature that was designed but never wired up, and the models.dart barrel that exists to re-export them is itself imported by nothing. Each carries a generated .freezed.dart companion that build_runner keeps regenerating for code nothing calls.
finding.recommendation: Delete chazara_status.dart, momentum_status.dart, their .freezed.dart companions, and models.dart, or land the provider/widget that was supposed to consume them.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rln 'ChazaraStatus\|MomentumStatus' lib/ returns zero results outside the deleted files, or shows a real consumer.
dart run build_runner build after deletion produces no orphaned .freezed.dart output for these files.

finding.title: Clean up stale dashboard feature scaffolding: unpopulated barrel + redundant .gitkeep files

evidence.quote: // Populated in Wave 5 (W5.x) — dashboard domain and UI cleanup.

finding.why: dashboard.dart claims to be 'Populated in Wave 5' and to be the required cross-feature entry point, but exports nothing — confirmed by repo-wide grep, nothing imports it, so today it's a documentation claim rather than an enforced boundary. Separately, four .gitkeep placeholders (domain/use_cases, presentation/providers, presentation/screens, presentation/widgets) exist purely to keep an empty directory tracked in git, but each of those directories has held real source files since the feature was built out (presentation/widgets alone now has 20 real files) — the placeholders are leftover noise in every directory listing.
finding.recommendation: Either populate dashboard.dart's exports (if/when another feature needs the barrel) or delete it and remove the header comment's claim; git rm the four stale .gitkeep files in now-nonempty directories.
acceptance_criteria: find lib/features/dashboard -name .gitkeep only matches directories that ls shows as otherwise empty.
dashboard.dart either has at least one export or is deleted.

finding.title: Remove the discarded initialSyncComplete watch in DashboardBody.build (unnecessary rebuild)

evidence.quote:
// ignore: unused_local_variable — retained for historical documentation.
    final _ = initialSyncComplete;

finding.why: The value is watched, then explicitly discarded into `_`, and the discard is only possible because the team suppressed the unused_local_variable lint. DashboardBody is a ConsumerWidget rebuilt on every dashboard change; it still re-subscribes to and rebuilds on every emission of initialSyncCompleteProvider purely to throw the value away — 'retained for historical documentation' belongs in a plain code comment, not a live ref.watch with a lint bypass.
finding.recommendation: Delete lines 149-150 and 217-218; if the history needs preserving, say so in a plain comment instead of a watched-and-discarded variable.
acceptance_criteria: grep -n initialSyncComplete on dashboard_body.dart returns nothing (or a real conditional use), and the ignore: unused_local_variable comment is gone.

finding.title: Move parent_dashboard_aggregator tests from test/features/parent_mode/ to the AG-5 mirrored path
finding.why: parent_dashboard_aggregator.dart lives in lib/features/dashboard/domain/services/, alongside track_completion_service.dart and next_reward_selector.dart, both correctly tested at test/features/dashboard/domain/services/. All four of parent_dashboard_aggregator.dart's own tests (_test.dart, _compute_test.dart, _extended_test.dart, _migration_test.dart) instead live under test/features/parent_mode/domain/services/ — a directory with no lib/features/parent_mode/ counterpart at all (the digest itself flags test/features/parent_mode as an unmirrored directory needing an AG-5 judgment call). The tests still exercise real, live code (parentDashboardDataProvider is genuinely consumed by the profiles feature), so this is pure path drift from an old feature name/rename, not stale testing of dead code — but a contributor relying on the 1:1 mirror convention to find this file's tests will not find them at the expected path.
finding.recommendation: git mv the four test files to test/features/dashboard/domain/services/, updating only their location — no code changes needed.
acceptance_criteria: An AG-5 checker (diff of lib/ vs test/ directory trees) reports zero unmirrored lib files with tests parked elsewhere for parent_dashboard_aggregator.dart.
The relevant story/epic test target still passes after the move.
